versions.changelog: 中英双语描述，方便全球用户搜索使用

- Initial release of liaogong-ocr, version 1.0.0.
- Dual OCR engine: combines easyocr and tesseract for improved results.
- Features 15 configurable pre-processing chains; optimal for mobile screen digit recognition with 87% accuracy.
- Supports multiple usage modes: CLI tool, Python library, and integration as an AI Agent.
- Suitable for Chinese posters, screenshots, English documents, and batch image-to-text conversions.
